title: Timetable – Form 8B
key_sentences: This timetable applies from Monday 8 September 2025 until the October half-term.
Lessons shaded green are double lessons and take place in the same room without a break.
Pupils who arrive after 08:50 must sign in at the main office.
Changes to this timetable are announced in the weekly bulletin.

list_items.text: PE kit is needed on Monday afternoons, including trainers for indoor use.
Science on Wednesday morning takes place in Lab 2 while Lab 1 is refitted.
Music on Friday is in the main hall until the music block reopens.
Homework is set in the planner and checked during Friday form tutor time.

notes: Each lesson cell holds two lines, subject and room; the cell text joins them with one space ('Mathematics Room M4'). Double lessons span two rows and break rows (Registration and assembly, Break, Lunch) span the five day columns; merged text is repeated in every covered grid cell. Times use an en dash (U+2013), and so does the title. The small 'Timetable office · Printed 1 September 2025' line at the bottom right is furniture.
